title: HP1 β and densely packed chromatin form separate microdomains in mouse ES cells, which are reconfigured upon exit from naïve pluripotency
authors: Ochirova A; Shah D; Zhang Z; Ponjavic A; Uzwyshyn-Jones K; Lando D; Wiese M; Ma X; Reynolds N; Koulle A; Boucher W; Lenz MO; Hendrich BD; Klenerman D; Laue ED
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小鼠ES细胞中HP1β与高密度DNA形成分离微域及其在多能性退出中的重构，涉及染色质结构与转录调控，但未聚焦TF-DNA结合建模，且方法为实验观测而非AI或物理模拟，仅对蛋白-DNA互作机制有间接参考价值。
abstract: Heterochromatin proteins play a key role in establishing local chromatin structure to control the transcription of target genes. Here we uncover a surprising segregation between regions of high DNA- and high heterochromatin protein 1 β (HP1 β )-density in mouse ES cells. DNA-low/HP1 β -high foci retain freely diffusing HP1 β , and form via condensation through a multitude of weak interactions on top of HP1 β that is bound stably to chromatin. DNA-high/HP1 β -low foci exclude freely diffusing HP1 β and display reduced chromatin mobility, suggesting a higher degree of chromatin self-interaction and a more repressive environment. Finally, the two types of environments are intertwined in DNA-high/HP1 β -high foci, where HP1 β maintains heterochromatin in a more compact yet dynamic chromatin state. During the exit from naïve pluripotency HP1 β is lost from regions of high DNA density as cells transition through the formative state, which might facilitate the reconfiguration of genome structure accompanying a change in cell state that we observed previously. Subsequently, as cells enter primed pluripotency, canonical heterochromatin is established.
abstract_zh: 异染色质蛋白在建立局部染色质结构以控制靶基因转录中发挥关键作用。在此，我们揭示了小鼠胚胎干细胞中高DNA密度区域与高异染色质蛋白1β（HP1β）密度区域之间的惊人分离。DNA低/HP1β高焦点保留自由扩散的HP1β，并通过在稳定结合于染色质的HP1β之上经由大量弱相互作用发生凝聚而形成。DNA高/HP1β低焦点排除自由扩散的HP1β，并显示染色质流动性降低，表明染色质自相互作用程度更高，环境更具抑制性。最后，这两种类型的环境在DNA高/HP1β高焦点中交织在一起，其中HP1β将异染色质维持在更紧凑但动态的染色质状态。在退出初始多能性过程中，当细胞通过形成状态过渡时，HP1β从高DNA密度区域丢失，这可能促进我们先前观察到的伴随细胞状态变化的基因组结构重构。随后，当细胞进入启动多能性时，典型异染色质得以建立。
